spec.title: RL state timeline
spec.description: Training state lanes and successful SGLang calls grouped by replica on one time axis. Replica rows show the union of overlapping returned client calls, including network/Router waiting and HTTP retries, not pure engine execution time. Successful request attribution is enabled with RL-Insight. Replica selection filters generation rows only; model selection applies only to native engine metrics. Narrow the time range if a 1000-result trace search limit is reached. Training and replica lanes are partitioned by experiment to keep All/multiple selections separate.

spec.query: {resource.service.name = "rl_insight_monitor" && span.project =~ `^${project:regex}$` && span.experiment_name =~ `^${experiment_name:regex}$` && ((span.monitor.trace_segment = "state_interval" && span.state_name =~ "^(ref_compute_log_prob|actor_compute_log_prob|actor_update|train_batch)$" && span.state_lane_id != "") || (span.monitor.trace_segment = "request_replica" && name = "sglang_generate_replica" && span.replica >= 0 && span.outcome = "returned" && span.observation_side = "client" && span.duration_semantics = "client_logical_call"))} | select(span.experiment_name, span.state_lane_id, span.state_name, span.replica, span.outcome)

spec.title: SGLang: End-to-End Request Latency
spec.description: P50, P90, P99 and mean end-to-end request latency, separated by model and replica.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (experiment_name, le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`, model=~`^${sglang_model:regex}$`, replica=~`^${sglang_replica:regex}$`}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (experiment_name, le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`, model=~`^${sglang_model:regex}$`, replica=~`^${sglang_replica:regex}$`}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (experiment_name, le, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`, model=~`^${sglang_model:regex}$`, replica=~`^${sglang_replica:regex}$`}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0))

sum by (experiment_name, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`, model=~`^${sglang_model:regex}$`, replica=~`^${sglang_replica:regex}$`}[$__rate_interval]) >= 0) / sum by (experiment_name, model, model_name, replica) (rate({__name__=~"sglang[:_]e2e_request_latency_seconds_count", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`, model=~`^${sglang_model:regex}$`, replica=~`^${sglang_replica:regex}$`}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)

spec.name: datasource
spec.description: Prometheus datasource used by scalar and engine panels.

spec.name: project
spec.label: Project
spec.description: Single RL-Insight project. The default is slime; custom values are allowed.

spec.name: experiment_name
spec.label: Experiment
spec.description: All experiments by default. Select one or more experiments or enter a custom value. Options reflect the selected time range.

spec.name: sglang_model
spec.label: SGLang model
spec.description: Static target model label added when Slime registers SGLang endpoints.

spec.query: label_values({__name__=~"sglang[:_]gen_throughput", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`}, model)

spec.name: sglang_replica
spec.label: SGLang replica
spec.description: Serving replica filter for native SGLang metrics and successful generation-call rows.

spec.query: label_values({__name__=~"sglang[:_]gen_throughput", project=~`^${project:regex}$`, experiment_name=~`^${experiment_name:regex}$`, model=~`^${sglang_model:regex}$`}, replica)
